title: Replace local caregiver JWT authority with Supabase validation
objective: Make FastAPI accept only verified Supabase caregiver access tokens and resolve them through a local domain-profile mapping without retaining a competing password/JWT authority.
acceptance_criteria: Old Mente password/JWT routes no longer authenticate caregivers
Supabase issuer, audience, expiry, signature, algorithm, subject, and authenticated role are verified
Local profile mapping uses auth_user_id and never dynamic email linking
Tests cover valid, expired, wrong issuer/audience/role, and legacy-token rejection

result.summary: Supabase-only caregiver validation, explicit profile onboarding, OpenAPI security metadata, an Alembic migration, and focused contract/security tests are complete.
